suppress.notes: Temporary release exception for CVE-2026-47884. XsltView SSRF/RCE. BOSS has no XsltView. NVD also attaches this CVE to spring-core and spring-web through the shared Spring Framework CPE. Open-source fix: Spring Framework 7.0.9, which requires Spring Boot 4. Framework 6.2.20 is enterprise-only.

Temporary release exception for CVE-2026-47890. SSE view-fragment stream corruption. Spring rates this low. BOSS does not emit SSE. Open-source fix: Spring Framework 7.0.9, which requires Spring Boot 4.
Not applicable on this runtime. CVE-2026-47891 is a WebFlux Aalto XML limit bypass. BOSS is Spring MVC on Tomcat and does not use WebFlux. Deferred with the Boot 4 upgrade.
Not applicable on this runtime. CVE-2026-47892 is a WebFlux functional-endpoint header bypass. BOSS does not use WebFlux functional endpoints. Deferred with the Boot 4 upgrade.
Not applicable on this runtime. CVE-2026-59313 is functional-endpoint SSE stream corruption. BOSS does not use the functional web framework or SSE. Deferred with the Boot 4 upgrade.
Not applicable on this runtime. CVE-2026-47885 is a WebFlux multipart reader limit. BOSS does not use WebFlux. Deferred with the Boot 4 upgrade.
Not applicable on this runtime. CVE-2026-47888 is an RSocket SETUP-frame leak. BOSS does not use RSocket. Deferred with the Boot 4 upgrade.
Not applicable on this runtime. CVE-2026-47889 is Jetty 12 cookie serialization. BOSS runs embedded Tomcat. Deferred with the Boot 4 upgrade.
Not applicable on this runtime. CVE-2026-47893 is a WebFlux WebSocket header leak. BOSS does not expose WebSocket. Deferred with the Boot 4 upgrade.

Deferred. CVE-2026-47886 is user-supplied SpEL denial of service. BOSS application code does not evaluate SpEL. Residual risk is any future endpoint that evaluates caller-supplied expressions. Open-source fix requires Spring Boot 4.

Deferred. CVE-2026-59283 is a SimpleEvaluationContext safety-guard bypass. BOSS application code does not evaluate SpEL. Residual risk is framework code that evaluates expressions over caller-controlled input. Open-source fix requires Spring Boot 4.

Deferred. CVE-2026-59282 is Spring data-binding of user-supplied property paths. Current controllers bind simple request parameters and JSON bodies. They do not bind arbitrary form property paths. Residual risk: a future form-binding endpoint would be exposed until the Boot 4 upgrade.
Not applicable. CVE-2026-59270 is the embedded UnboundID LDAP server in Spring Security tests. BOSS does not start UnboundIdContainer. Authentication is Firebase JWT.
Not applicable. CVE-2026-47841 is Spring Security WebAuthn user-verification bypass. BOSS does not enable WebAuthn.
Not applicable. CVE-2026-41707 is Spring Security DPoP proof replay. BOSS does not use DPoP.
False positive. CVE-2004-0455 is a 2004 flaw in the unrelated www-sql project. Dependency-Check matches the CPE to com.google.cloud:google-cloud-sql and proto-google-cloud-sql-v1.
False positive. CVE-2026-0994 is a Python protobuf ParseDict recursion bug. It is matched by CPE to the Java protobuf-java artifacts.
False positive. CVE-2026-39883 is an OpenTelemetry Go Darwin ioreg bug, matched by CPE to Java OpenTelemetry jars.
False positive. CVE-2026-24051 is an OpenTelemetry Go path-hijacking bug, matched by CPE to Java OpenTelemetry jars.
False positive. CVE-2026-29181 is an OpenTelemetry Go baggage-header bug, matched by CPE to Java OpenTelemetry jars.

False positive. CVE-2026-34479 is Log4j1XmlLayout in the Log4j 1-to-2 bridge. The scanned artifact is log4j-api, which does not contain that class. The fail line reports CVSS 6.9, below the gate, but Dependency-Check still fails the dependency.
